prompt:

Edit target: the supplied clean portrait photographic basalt image. Create the final SEALED, completely cooled material state as an exact matching image for a smooth crossfade.
Change ONLY the thermal state of the existing seam: turn every incandescent white, yellow, orange, and red part of the fissure completely black. The lava within has fully solidified and contracted into a closed dark mineral trace. Preserve the exact wandering path of the seam, but make it a subtle black-on-black healed line with very shallow cool graphite mineral detail, no open luminous gap. Remove every warm reflection and every orange or red cast on the adjacent inner walls. There must be zero remaining glow or warm coloration anywhere, including top entrance, center, the lower-right bright stretch and the right image edge.
Strict invariants: keep exactly the same portrait aspect ratio and canvas dimensions, exact rock silhouette, exact camera, crop, rock position, huge rugged basalt face, original black empty area at the top, all rough pores and ridges outside the seam, and the existing cool neutral grazing light on the stone. No changing object coordinates, no rotation, no zoom, no new object, no added smoke, no background change. Let only the inner heat become cooled black stone. Dark, dense, quiet material; fine surface texture still visible in neutral light.
Output a single matching production photograph. No text, symbols, interface, border or watermark.
